title: news scores label
description: Record Huddle's pairwise labels from a JSON file (or - for stdin): {"labels": [{"a": 12, "b": 15, "winner": "a"}]}, one to 200 labels, each naming two scored stories and which deserved a page first. Board's form sends the same labels over the Hotline (`huddle.answer`). Input is the command's arguments as an object; output is the envelope's data.
